detachments.name: Ceramite Sentinels

rule.name: Adaptive Defence
rule.rules_text: While a friendly ADEPTUS ASTARTES unit is within a terrain area, that unit's attacks can re-roll Wound rolls of 1. Friendly ADEPTUS ASTARTES units are entrenched while all models in that unit are within a terrain area, that unit was not set up this turn, and no model in that unit moved more than 3" this turn. Friendly DARNATH LYSANDER/TOR GARADON units have Defensive Mastery: at the start of each phase, this unit is entrenched. DARNATH LYSANDER/TOR GARADON units are always entrenched.

restrictions: Your army can include IMPERIAL FISTS units, but it cannot include ADEPTUS ASTARTES units drawn from any other Chapter.

enhancements.name: Honour Indefatigable
enhancements.rules_text: GRAVIS model only. Once per battle, per army, at the end of a phase in which this model is destroyed, roll one D6. On a 2+, set this model back up on the battlefield as close as possible to where it was destroyed, unengaged, with 3 wounds remaining.

enhancements.name: Castellum Omnivox
enhancements.rules_text: ADEPTUS ASTARTES unit only. When this unit makes an Advance or Fall Back move, that move does not prevent this unit from being eligible to start an action.

enhancements.name: Defensive Mastery
enhancements.rules_text: ADEPTUS ASTARTES model only. When both players have deployed their armies, you can redeploy up to three ADEPTUS ASTARTES INFANTRY units. You can set those units up in Strategic Reserves, regardless of how many units are already in Strategic Reserves.

enhancements.name: Spy-skull Data Link
enhancements.rules_text: ADEPTUS ASTARTES unit only. This unit's ranged weapons have [IGNORES COVER].

stratagems.name: Unyielding Might
stratagems.target: One friendly ADEPTUS ASTARTES unit that is within range of an objective.
stratagems.effect: Your unit has +1 OC until the end of the turn.

stratagems.name: Stand to the End
stratagems.when: Your opponent's Shooting phase or the Fight phase, when an enemy unit targets a friendly ADEPTUS ASTARTES unit (excluding MONSTER/VEHICLE units).
stratagems.effect: Attacks that target your unit with a Strength greater than your unit's Toughness have -1 to Wound rolls. If your unit is entrenched, attacks that target your unit have -1 to Wound rolls instead.

stratagems.name: Augmented Targeting
stratagems.when: Your Shooting phase or the Fight phase, when a friendly ADEPTUS ASTARTES unit is selected to attack.
stratagems.effect: Your unit's attacks have [LETHAL HITS]. If your unit is entrenched, those attacks also have [SUSTAINED HITS 1].

stratagems.name: Establish Supremacy
stratagems.when: Fight phase, when a friendly entrenched ADEPTUS ASTARTES INFANTRY unit is selected to make a Consolidation move.
stratagems.effect: You can select the objective consolidation mode for that Consolidation move, regardless of that mode's conditions.

stratagems.name: Priority Strike
stratagems.when: Your Shooting phase or the Fight phase, when a friendly ADEPTUS ASTARTES INFANTRY/MOUNTED unit is selected to attack.
stratagems.effect: Your unit's attacks that target a MONSTER/VEHICLE unit have +1 to Wound rolls.

stratagems.name: Evasive Repositioning
stratagems.when: Your opponent's Shooting phase, when an enemy unit has shot.
stratagems.target: One friendly unengaged ADEPTUS ASTARTES INFANTRY/MOUNTED unit that lost a wound as a result of those attacks.
stratagems.effect: Your unit can make a Normal move of up to D6". If your unit is entrenched, it can make a Normal move of up to D3+3" instead. Your unit is eligible to embark within a TRANSPORT until the end of the turn.

abilities.name: Rampart
abilities.rules_text: Once per battle, per army, at the start of any phase, you can use this ability. If you do, this model has a 2+ invulnerable save until the end of the phase.

abilities.name: Icon of Obstinacy
abilities.rules_text: Attacks that target this unit have -1 to Hit rolls.

leader.rules_text: This model can be attached to Terminator Assault Squad and Terminator Squad units.

abilities.name: Siege Captain
abilities.rules_text: This model's attacks that target a FORTIFICATION/MONSTER/VEHICLE unit have +2 Strength, Armour Penetration and Damage.

abilities.name: Signum Array
abilities.rules_text: In your Shooting phase, you can select one visible enemy unit within 18 inches of this unit. That enemy unit cannot have the Benefit of Cover.

leader.rules_text: This model can be attached to Aggressor Squad, Eradicator Squad with Heavy Bolters, Eradicator Squad with Melta Rifles and Heavy Intercessor Squad units.
